columns.name: present_post_office
columns.comment: Present-address post office or ডাকঘর, entered in English and used to compose present_address_bn.

columns.name: permanent_post_office
columns.comment: Permanent-address post office or ডাকঘর, entered in English and used to compose permanent_address_bn.

columns.name: present_address_details
columns.comment: Optional present-address village, area, house, street, or road detail.

columns.name: permanent_address_details
columns.comment: Optional permanent-address village, area, house, street, or road detail.

columns.name: notification_id
columns.comment: Authoritative user notification associated with this delivery attempt.

columns.name: subscription_id
columns.comment: Target device subscription when channel is WebPush.

columns.name: delivery_status
columns.comment: Pending, Processing, Sent, Delivered, Failed, Skipped or Cancelled.

columns.name: response_metadata
columns.comment: Non-secret provider response metadata used for delivery diagnostics.

columns.name: rule_key
columns.comment: Stable unique identifier for an escalation policy.

columns.name: first_repeat_after_minutes
columns.comment: Delay before repeating the unresolved notification to the original recipient.

columns.name: escalation_after_minutes
columns.comment: Delay before creating a separate notification for an authorized escalation recipient.

columns.name: repeat_every_minutes
columns.comment: Optional controlled recurrence interval after the first repeat or escalation.

columns.name: maximum_repeat_count
columns.comment: Optional maximum number of controlled repeat notifications.

columns.name: project_scope_required
columns.comment: Requires the escalation recipient project scope to match the notification project context.

columns.name: event_key
columns.comment: Stable unique business-event key used to prevent duplicate event creation.

columns.name: event_payload
columns.comment: Structured event context. Secrets and unnecessary sensitive information must not be stored here.

columns.name: notification_id
columns.comment: Notification processed by this job, when applicable.

columns.name: event_id
columns.comment: Business event processed by this job, when applicable.

columns.name: job_type
columns.comment: Job operation such as ProcessEvent, DeliverNotification, RepeatNotification, EscalateNotification or ExpireNotification.

columns.name: run_at
columns.comment: UTC timestamp when this job becomes eligible for processing.

columns.name: locked_by
columns.comment: Identifier of the server processor that acquired the job lock.

columns.name: job_payload
columns.comment: Structured non-secret processing context for this job.

columns.name: category
columns.comment: Notification category. The value * represents the user-wide default preference.

columns.name: minimum_priority
columns.comment: Lowest notification priority enabled for this user and category.

columns.name: urgent_bypass_enabled
columns.comment: Allows Urgent notifications to bypass quiet hours.

columns.name: timezone
columns.comment: IANA timezone used for quiet-hours and reminder calculations.

columns.name: recipient_user_id
columns.comment: Authenticated profile that owns this notification and its read/action state.

columns.name: action_params
columns.comment: Structured deep-link and action context. Sensitive secrets must not be stored here.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Scheduled, Ready, Delivered, Read, Actioned, Snoozed, Completed, Dismissed, Expired, Cancelled or Failed.

columns.name: dedupe_key
columns.comment: Stable per-workflow key used with recipient ownership to prevent duplicate open notifications.

columns.name: parent_notification_id
columns.comment: Original notification when this row is an escalation or controlled follow-up.

columns.name: project_record_id
columns.comment: Text representation of public.projects.id.

columns.name: meeting_attendance_enabled
columns.comment: TRUE when an operationally active project participates in Meeting Attendance; FALSE hides it only from the Meeting Attendance scope and calculations.

columns.name: endpoint
columns.comment: Sensitive Web Push capability endpoint. Must not be exposed to unauthorized users.

columns.name: endpoint_hash
columns.comment: Deterministic endpoint hash used for duplicate prevention without routine endpoint disclosure.

columns.name: p256dh_key
columns.comment: Browser-provided Web Push encryption public key.

columns.name: auth_key
columns.comment: Browser-provided Web Push authentication secret.

columns.name: device_label
columns.comment: User-friendly device name used in notification settings.

columns.name: failure_count
columns.comment: Consecutive or accumulated delivery failures used for subscription health management.

columns.name: owner_user_id
columns.comment: Authenticated user who owns or created the To-Do record.

columns.name: assigned_to_user_id
columns.comment: Authenticated user responsible for acting on the To-Do and receiving reminders.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_apply_lifecycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_now timestamp with time zone := now();
begin
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- Terminal notifications cannot return to an active state.
  -- Any future administrative correction should use a separate,
  -- explicit server-controlled function.
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  if tg_op = 'UPDATE'
     and old.status in (
       'Completed',
       'Dismissed',
       'Expired',
       'Cancelled'
     )
     and new.status is distinct from old.status then

    raise exception using
      errcode = '23514',
      message = format(
        'Notification cannot transition from terminal status %s to %s',
        old.status,
        new.status
      );
  end if;

  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- Delivered
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  if new.status = 'Delivered' then
    new.first_delivered_at :=
      coalesce(
        new.first_delivered_at,
        case
          when tg_op = 'UPDATE'
            then old.first_delivered_at
          else null
        end,
        v_now
      );

    new.last_delivered_at := v_now;
  end if;

  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- Read
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  if new.status = 'Read' then
    new.read_at :=
      coalesce(
        new.read_at,
        case
          when tg_op = 'UPDATE'
            then old.read_at
          else null
        end,
        v_now
      );
  end if;

  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- Actioned
  -- Opening an actionable notification also counts as read.
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  if new.status = 'Actioned' then
    new.actioned_at :=
      coalesce(
        new.actioned_at,
        case
          when tg_op = 'UPDATE'
            then old.actioned_at
          else null
        end,
        v_now
      );

    new.read_at :=
      coalesce(
        new.read_at,
        case
          when tg_op = 'UPDATE'
            then old.read_at
          else null
        end,
        v_now
      );
  end if;

  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- Snoozed
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  if new.status = 'Snoozed' then
    if new.snoozed_until is null then
      raise exception using
        errcode = '23514',
        message =
          'snoozed_until is required when notification status is Snoozed';
    end if;

    if new.snoozed_until <= v_now then
      raise exception using
        errcode = '23514',
        message =
          'snoozed_until must be in the future';
    end if;

    -- The notification becomes eligible again at snoozed_until.
    new.scheduled_for := new.snoozed_until;
  end if;

  -- Clear obsolete snooze state after leaving Snoozed.
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE'
     and old.status = 'Snoozed'
     and new.status is distinct from 'Snoozed' then

    new.snoozed_until := null;
  end if;

  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- Completed
  -- Completion also counts as read and actioned.
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  if new.status = 'Completed' then
    new.completed_at :=
      coalesce(
        new.completed_at,
        case
          when tg_op = 'UPDATE'
            then old.completed_at
          else null
        end,
        v_now
      );

    new.actioned_at :=
      coalesce(
        new.actioned_at,
        case
          when tg_op = 'UPDATE'
            then old.actioned_at
          else null
        end,
        v_now
      );

    new.read_at :=
      coalesce(
        new.read_at,
        case
          when tg_op = 'UPDATE'
            then old.read_at
          else null
        end,
        v_now
      );

    new.snoozed_until := null;
  end if;

  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- Dismissed
  -- Dismissal counts as read, but not as workflow completion.
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  if new.status = 'Dismissed' then
    new.dismissed_at :=
      coalesce(
        new.dismissed_at,
        case
          when tg_op = 'UPDATE'
            then old.dismissed_at
          else null
        end,
        v_now
      );

    new.read_at :=
      coalesce(
        new.read_at,
        case
          when tg_op = 'UPDATE'
            then old.read_at
          else null
        end,
        v_now
      );

    new.snoozed_until := null;
  end if;

  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- Expired or Cancelled
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  if new.status in (
    'Expired',
    'Cancelled'
  ) then
    new.snoozed_until := null;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_check_core_source(p_entity_type text, p_entity_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_resolved boolean;
  v_state text;
begin
  if p_entity_id is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'Entity ID is required';
  end if;

  if lower(btrim(coalesce(p_entity_type, ''))) = 'todo' then

    select
      (
        t.deleted_at is not null
        or t.solved_at is not null
        or lower(btrim(coalesce(t.status, ''))) in (
          'completed',
          'complete',
          'solved',
          'closed',
          'cancelled',
          'solved_approved',
          'solved_rejected'
        )
      ),
      coalesce(t.status, '[blank]')
    into
      v_resolved,
      v_state
    from public.todos t
    where t.id = p_entity_id;

  elsif lower(btrim(coalesce(p_entity_type, ''))) =
    'transfer' then

    select
      t.status in (
        'Completed',
        'Cancelled'
      ),
      t.status
    into
      v_resolved,
      v_state
    from public.transfers t
    where t.id = p_entity_id
      and t.deleted_at is null;

  elsif lower(btrim(coalesce(p_entity_type, ''))) =
    'exit' then

    select
      e.status in (
        'Completed',
        'Cancelled'
      ),
      e.status
    into
      v_resolved,
      v_state
    from public.exits e
    where e.id = p_entity_id
      and e.deleted_at is null;

  else
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'Unsupported core source type';
  end if;

  if v_state is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = 'P0002',
      message = 'Source workflow record not found';
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'entity_type',
    lower(btrim(p_entity_type)),
    'entity_id',
    p_entity_id,
    'resolved',
    coalesce(v_resolved, false),
    'state',
    v_state
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_check_uniform_source(p_entity_type text, p_entity_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_type text;
  v_resolved boolean;
  v_state text;
begin
  v_type := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_entity_type, '')));

  if p_entity_id is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'Entity ID is required';
  end if;

  if v_type = 'uniform_supply_order' then
    select
      u.status in ('Completed', 'Cancelled'),
      u.status
    into v_resolved, v_state
    from public.uniform_supply_orders u
    where u.id = p_entity_id;

  elsif v_type = 'uniform_delivery_issue' then
    select
      i.resolution_status in ('Resolved', 'Cancelled'),
      i.resolution_status
    into v_resolved, v_state
    from public.uniform_delivery_issues i
    where i.id = p_entity_id;

  elsif v_type = 'uniform_delivery_bill' then
    select
      b.paid = true,
      case
        when b.paid then 'Paid'
        when b.head_office_confirmed then 'Confirmed, payment pending'
        else 'Confirmation pending'
      end
    into v_resolved, v_state
    from public.uniform_delivery_bills b
    where b.id = p_entity_id;

  else
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'Unsupported Uniform source type';
  end if;

  if v_state is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = 'P0002',
      message = 'Uniform source record not found';
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'entity_type', v_type,
    'entity_id', p_entity_id,
    'resolved', coalesce(v_resolved, false),
    'state', v_state
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_claim_jobs(p_worker_id text, p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS SETOF notification_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_worker_id, '')), '') is null then
    raise exception 'Worker ID is required';
  end if;

  if length(btrim(p_worker_id)) > 200 then
    raise exception 'Worker ID cannot exceed 200 characters';
  end if;

  if p_batch_size is null
     or p_batch_size < 1
     or p_batch_size > 100 then
    raise exception 'Batch size must be between 1 and 100';
  end if;

  return query
  with claimable as (
    select j.id
    from public.notification_jobs j
    where j.job_status in ('Pending', 'Failed')
      and j.run_at <= clock_timestamp()
      and j.attempt_count < j.maximum_attempts
    order by j.run_at, j.id
    limit p_batch_size
    for update skip locked
  )
  update public.notification_jobs j
  set
    job_status = 'Processing',
    attempt_count = j.attempt_count + 1,
    locked_at = clock_timestamp(),
    locked_by = btrim(p_worker_id),
    started_at = clock_timestamp(),
    completed_at = null,
    failed_at = null,
    last_error = null
  from claimable c
  where j.id = c.id
  returning j.*;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_claim_web_push_jobs(p_worker_id text, p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS SETOF notification_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

AS $function$
begin

     or p_batch_size < 1
     or p_batch_size > 25 then
    raise exception

  end if;

  return query
  with claimable as (
    select job_row.id
    from public.notification_jobs job_row
    where job_row.job_type =
      'DeliverWebPush'
      and job_row.job_status in (
        'Pending',
        'Failed'
      )
      and job_row.run_at <=
        clock_timestamp()
      and job_row.attempt_count <
        job_row.maximum_attempts
    order by
      job_row.run_at,
      job_row.id
    limit p_batch_size
    for update skip locked
  )
  update public.notification_jobs job_row
  set
    job_status = 'Processing',
    attempt_count =
      job_row.attempt_count + 1,
    locked_at = clock_timestamp(),
    locked_by = btrim(p_worker_id),
    started_at = clock_timestamp(),
    completed_at = null,
    failed_at = null,
    last_error = null
  from claimable claim_row
  where job_row.id = claim_row.id
  returning job_row.*;
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_complete_job(p_job_id bigint, p_worker_id text)
 RETURNS notification_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_job public.notification_jobs;
begin
  if p_job_id is null then
    raise exception 'Job ID is required';
  end if;

  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_worker_id, '')), '') is null then
    raise exception 'Worker ID is required';
  end if;

  update public.notification_jobs
  set
    job_status = 'Completed',
    completed_at = clock_timestamp(),
    failed_at = null,
    last_error = null,
    locked_at = null,
    locked_by = null
  where id = p_job_id
    and job_status = 'Processing'
    and locked_by = btrim(p_worker_id)
  returning *

  if v_job.id is null then
    raise exception
      'Job % is not Processing or is not owned by worker %',
      p_job_id,
      btrim(p_worker_id);
  end if;

  return v_job;
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_effective_preference(p_user_id uuid, p_category text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_pref public.notification_preferences%rowtype;
  v_category text;
begin
  if p_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'User ID is required';
  end if;

  v_category := coalesce(
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_category, '')), ''),
    'System'
  );

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = p_user_id
      and p.is_active = true
  ) then
    raise exception
      'Notification recipient is missing or inactive';
  end if;

  select pref.*
  into v_pref
  from public.notification_preferences pref
  where pref.user_id = p_user_id
    and pref.category in (v_category, '*')
  order by
    case
      when pref.category = v_category then 0
      else 1
    end,
    pref.id
  limit 1;

  if v_pref.id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'source_category', 'system-default',
      'notification_enabled', true,
      'in_app_enabled', true,
      'toast_enabled', true,
      'system_push_enabled', true,
      'minimum_priority', 'Low',
      'quiet_hours_enabled', true,
      'quiet_hours_start', '22:00:00',
      'quiet_hours_end', '07:00:00',
      'urgent_bypass_enabled', true,
      'timezone', 'Asia/Dhaka',
      'default_snooze_minutes', 15,
      'toast_max_visible', 2,
      'toast_gap_seconds', 60
    );
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'preference_id', v_pref.id,
    'source_category', v_pref.category,
    'notification_enabled', v_pref.notification_enabled,
    'in_app_enabled', v_pref.in_app_enabled,
    'toast_enabled', v_pref.toast_enabled,
    'system_push_enabled', v_pref.system_push_enabled,
    'minimum_priority', v_pref.minimum_priority,
    'quiet_hours_enabled', v_pref.quiet_hours_enabled,
    'quiet_hours_start', v_pref.quiet_hours_start::text,
    'quiet_hours_end', v_pref.quiet_hours_end::text,
    'urgent_bypass_enabled', v_pref.urgent_bypass_enabled,
    'timezone', v_pref.timezone,
    'default_snooze_minutes',
      v_pref.default_snooze_minutes,
    'toast_max_visible', v_pref.toast_max_visible,
    'toast_gap_seconds', v_pref.toast_gap_seconds
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_enqueue_pending_events(p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_enqueued integer := 0;
begin
  if p_batch_size is null
     or p_batch_size < 1
     or p_batch_size > 200 then
    raise exception
      'Batch size must be between 1 and 200';
  end if;

  with pending_events as (
    select e.id
    from public.notification_events e
    where e.processing_status = 'Pending'
    order by e.occurred_at, e.id
    limit p_batch_size
    for update skip locked
  ),
  inserted_jobs as (
    insert into public.notification_jobs (
      event_id,
      job_type,
      run_at,
      job_status,
      attempt_count,
      maximum_attempts,
      job_payload
    )
    select
      p.id,
      'ProcessEvent',
      clock_timestamp(),
      'Pending',
      0,
      5,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'event_id', p.id,
        'queued_at', clock_timestamp()
      )
    from pending_events p
    on conflict do nothing
    returning id
  )
  select count(*)
  into v_enqueued
  from inserted_jobs;

  return v_enqueued;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_fail_job(p_job_id bigint, p_worker_id text, p_error text, p_retry_after interval DEFAULT '00:05:00'::interval)
 RETURNS notification_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_job public.notification_jobs;
begin
  if p_job_id is null then
    raise exception 'Job ID is required';
  end if;

  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_worker_id, '')), '') is null then
    raise exception 'Worker ID is required';
  end if;

  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_error, '')), '') is null then
    raise exception 'Failure diagnostics are required';
  end if;

  if p_retry_after is null
     or p_retry_after < interval '1 minute'
     or p_retry_after > interval '24 hours' then
    raise exception
      'Retry interval must be between 1 minute and 24 hours';
  end if;

  update public.notification_jobs
  set
    job_status = case
      when attempt_count >= maximum_attempts
        then 'DeadLetter'
      else 'Failed'
    end,
    run_at = case
      when attempt_count >= maximum_attempts
        then run_at
      else clock_timestamp() + p_retry_after
    end,
    failed_at = clock_timestamp(),
    completed_at = null,
    last_error = left(btrim(p_error), 4000),
    locked_at = null,
    locked_by = null
  where id = p_job_id
    and job_status = 'Processing'
    and locked_by = btrim(p_worker_id)
  returning *
  into v_job;

  if v_job.id is null then
    raise exception
      'Job % is not Processing or is not owned by worker %',
      p_job_id,
      btrim(p_worker_id);
  end if;

  return v_job;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_finalize_web_push_job(p_job_id bigint, p_worker_id text, p_retry_after interval DEFAULT '00:05:00'::interval)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_job public.notification_jobs%rowtype;
  v_pending integer := 0;
  v_failed integer := 0;
  v_sent integer := 0;
  v_result public.notification_jobs%rowtype;
begin
  if p_job_id is null then
    raise exception
      'Job ID is required';
  end if;

  if nullif(
    btrim(coalesce(p_worker_id, '')),
    ''
  ) is null then
    raise exception
      'Worker ID is required';
  end if;

  if p_retry_after is null
     or p_retry_after <
        interval '1 minute'
     or p_retry_after >
        interval '24 hours' then
    raise exception
      'Retry interval must be between 1 minute and 24 hours';
  end if;

  select job_row.*
  into v_job
  from public.notification_jobs job_row
  where job_row.id = p_job_id
    and job_row.job_type =
      'DeliverWebPush'
    and job_row.job_status =
      'Processing'
    and job_row.locked_by =
      btrim(p_worker_id);

  if not found then
    raise exception
      'Web Push job % is not Processing or is not owned by worker %',
      p_job_id,
      btrim(p_worker_id);
  end if;

  select
    count(*) filter (
      where delivery_status in (
        'Pending',
        'Processing'
      )
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where delivery_status =
        'Failed'
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where delivery_status in (
        'Sent',
        'Delivered'
      )
    )
  into
    v_pending,
    v_failed,
    v_sent
  from public.notification_deliveries
  where notification_id =
        v_job.notification_id
    and channel = 'WebPush';

  if v_pending > 0 then
    raise exception
      'Web Push job % still has % unfinished deliveries',
      p_job_id,
      v_pending;
  end if;

  if v_failed > 0 then
    v_result :=
      public.notification_fail_job(
        p_job_id,
        p_worker_id,
        format(
          '%s Web Push delivery attempt(s) failed; %s accepted',
          v_failed,
          v_sent
        ),
        p_retry_after
      );
  else
    v_result :=
      public.notification_complete_job(
        p_job_id,
        p_worker_id
      );
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'job_id',
      v_result.id,
    'job_status',
      v_result.job_status,
    'attempt_count',
      v_result.attempt_count,
    'maximum_attempts',
      v_result.maximum_attempts,
    'sent_deliveries',
      v_sent,
    'failed_deliveries',
      v_failed,
    'pending_deliveries',
      v_pending,
    'run_at',
      v_result.run_at
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_get_web_push_dispatch(p_job_id bigint, p_worker_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_job public.notification_jobs%rowtype;
  v_notification public.notifications%rowtype;
  v_deliveries jsonb;
begin
  if p_job_id is null then
    raise exception
      'Job ID is required';
  end if;

  if nullif(
    btrim(coalesce(p_worker_id, '')),
    ''
  ) is null then
    raise exception
      'Worker ID is required';
  end if;

  select job_row.*
  into v_job
  from public.notification_jobs job_row
  where job_row.id = p_job_id
    and job_row.job_type =
      'DeliverWebPush'
    and job_row.job_status =
      'Processing'
    and job_row.locked_by =
      btrim(p_worker_id);

  if not found then
    raise exception
      'Web Push job % is not Processing or is not owned by worker %',
      p_job_id,
      btrim(p_worker_id);
  end if;

  select notification_row.*
  into v_notification
  from public.notifications notification_row
  where notification_row.id =
    v_job.notification_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception
      'Notification for Web Push job % was not found',
      p_job_id;
  end if;

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'delivery_id',
          delivery_row.id,
        'subscription_id',
          subscription_row.id,
        'endpoint',
          subscription_row.endpoint,
        'keys',
          jsonb_build_object(
            'p256dh',
              subscription_row.p256dh_key,
            'auth',
              subscription_row.auth_key
          ),
        'attempt_number',
          delivery_row.attempt_number
      )
      order by delivery_row.id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_deliveries
  from public.notification_deliveries
    delivery_row
  join public.push_subscriptions
    subscription_row
    on subscription_row.id =
       delivery_row.subscription_id
  where delivery_row.notification_id =
        v_notification.id
    and delivery_row.channel =
        'WebPush'
    and delivery_row.delivery_status in (
      'Pending',
      'Failed'
    )
    and subscription_row.user_id =
        v_notification.recipient_user_id
    and subscription_row.is_active = true
    and subscription_row.permission_state =
        'granted'
    and subscription_row.revoked_at is null;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'job',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id',
          v_job.id,
        'attempt_count',
          v_job.attempt_count,
        'maximum_attempts',
          v_job.maximum_attempts
      ),
    'notification',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id',
          v_notification.id,
        'recipient_user_id',
          v_notification.recipient_user_id,
        'title',
          v_notification.title,
        'message',
          v_notification.message,
        'category',
          v_notification.category,
        'priority',
          v_notification.priority,
        'severity',
          v_notification.severity,
        'action_label',
          v_notification.action_label,
        'action_route',
          v_notification.action_route,
        'action_params',
          coalesce(
            v_notification.action_params,
            '{}'::jsonb
          ),
        'entity_type',
          v_notification.entity_type,
        'entity_id',
          v_notification.entity_id,
        'expires_at',
          v_notification.expires_at
      ),
    'deliveries',
      v_deliveries
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_operations_health()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'cron'
AS $function$
declare
  v_overdue_jobs bigint := 0;
  v_failed_jobs bigint := 0;
  v_deadletter_jobs bigint := 0;
  v_stale_jobs bigint := 0;

  v_unfinished_push bigint := 0;
  v_failed_push bigint := 0;
  v_successful_push bigint := 0;

  v_active_subscriptions bigint := 0;
  v_subscription_failures bigint := 0;
  v_unhealthy_subscriptions bigint := 0;
  v_inactive_subscriptions bigint := 0;

  v_processor_active boolean := false;
  v_sender_active boolean := false;
  v_maintenance_active boolean := false;

  v_processor_last_status text;
  v_sender_last_status text;
  v_maintenance_last_status text;

  v_healthy boolean := false;
begin
  select
    count(*) filter (
      where job_status = 'Pending'
        and run_at <= clock_timestamp()
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where job_status = 'Failed'
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where job_status = 'DeadLetter'
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where job_status = 'Processing'
        and locked_at <
          clock_timestamp() - interval '15 minutes'
    )
  into
    v_overdue_jobs,
    v_failed_jobs,
    v_deadletter_jobs,
    v_stale_jobs
  from public.notification_jobs;


  select
    count(*) filter (
      where channel = 'WebPush'
        and delivery_status in (
          'Pending',
          'Processing'
        )
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where channel = 'WebPush'
        and delivery_status = 'Failed'
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where channel = 'WebPush'
        and delivery_status in (
          'Sent',
          'Delivered'
        )
    )
  into
    v_unfinished_push,
    v_failed_push,
    v_successful_push
  from public.notification_deliveries;


  select
    count(*) filter (
      where is_active = true
        and permission_state = 'granted'
        and revoked_at is null
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where failure_count > 0
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where failure_count >= 5
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where is_active = false
         or revoked_at is not null
         or permission_state in (
           'denied',
           'revoked',
           'unsupported'
         )
    )
  into
    v_active_subscriptions,
    v_subscription_failures,
    v_unhealthy_subscriptions,
    v_inactive_subscriptions
  from public.push_subscriptions;


  select exists (
    select 1
    from cron.job
    where jobname = 'notification-server-processor'
      and active = true
  )
  into v_processor_active;

  select exists (
    select 1
    from cron.job
    where jobname = 'notification-web-push-sender'
      and active = true
  )
  into v_sender_active;

  select exists (
    select 1
    from cron.job
    where jobname = 'notification-operations-maintenance'
      and active = true
  )
  into v_maintenance_active;


  select run_row.status
  into v_processor_last_status
  from cron.job job_row
  join cron.job_run_details run_row
    on run_row.jobid = job_row.jobid
  where job_row.jobname = 'notification-server-processor'
  order by run_row.start_time desc
  limit 1;


  select run_row.status
  into v_sender_last_status
  from cron.job job_row
  join cron.job_run_details run_row
    on run_row.jobid = job_row.jobid
  where job_row.jobname = 'notification-web-push-sender'
  order by run_row.start_time desc
  limit 1;


  select run_row.status
  into v_maintenance_last_status
  from cron.job job_row
  join cron.job_run_details run_row
    on run_row.jobid = job_row.jobid
  where job_row.jobname = 'notification-operations-maintenance'
  order by run_row.start_time desc
  limit 1;


  /*
   * A newly-created maintenance Cron may not have executed yet.
   * A NULL first-run status is therefore accepted.
   * Any recorded non-success status makes health red.
   */
  v_healthy :=
    v_overdue_jobs = 0
    and v_failed_jobs = 0
    and v_deadletter_jobs = 0
    and v_stale_jobs = 0
    and v_unfinished_push = 0
    and v_failed_push = 0
    and v_unhealthy_subscriptions = 0
    and v_processor_active
    and v_sender_active
    and v_maintenance_active
    and v_processor_last_status = 'succeeded'
    and v_sender_last_status = 'succeeded'
    and (
      v_maintenance_last_status is null
      or v_maintenance_last_status = 'succeeded'
    );


  return jsonb_build_object(
    'healthy',
      v_healthy,

    'jobs',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'overdue_pending',
          v_overdue_jobs,
        'failed',
          v_failed_jobs,
        'deadletter',
          v_deadletter_jobs,
        'stale_processing',
          v_stale_jobs
      ),

    'web_push_deliveries',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'unfinished',
          v_unfinished_push,
        'failed',
          v_failed_push,
        'successful',
          v_successful_push
      ),

    'subscriptions',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'active',
          v_active_subscriptions,
        'with_failures',
          v_subscription_failures,
        'unhealthy',
          v_unhealthy_subscriptions,
        'inactive',
          v_inactive_subscriptions
      ),

    'cron',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'notification-server-processor',
          jsonb_build_object(
            'active',
              v_processor_active,
            'last_status',
              v_processor_last_status
          ),

        'notification-web-push-sender',
          jsonb_build_object(
            'active',
              v_sender_active,
            'last_status',
              v_sender_last_status
          ),

        'notification-operations-maintenance',
          jsonb_build_object(
            'active',
              v_maintenance_active,
            'last_status',
              v_maintenance_last_status,
            'first_run_pending',
              v_maintenance_last_status is null
          )
      ),

    'checked_at',
      clock_timestamp()
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_operations_maintenance()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_recovered integer := 0;
  v_health jsonb;
begin
  v_recovered :=
    public.notification_recover_stale_jobs(
      interval '15 minutes'
    );

  v_health :=
    public.notification_operations_health();

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'stale_jobs_recovered',
      v_recovered,

    'healthy',
      coalesce(
        (v_health ->> 'healthy')::boolean,
        false
      ),

    'jobs',
      v_health -> 'jobs',

    'web_push_deliveries',
      v_health -> 'web_push_deliveries',

    'subscriptions',
      v_health -> 'subscriptions',

    'finished_at',
      clock_timestamp()
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_prepare_deliveries(p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_notification public.notifications%rowtype;
  v_preference jsonb;

  v_expired integer := 0;
  v_promoted integer := 0;
  v_examined integer := 0;
  v_cancelled integer := 0;

  v_in_app_created integer := 0;
  v_push_deliveries_created integer := 0;
  v_push_jobs_created integer := 0;

  v_insert_count integer := 0;
  v_in_app_enabled boolean;
  v_push_enabled boolean;
  v_notification_enabled boolean;
  v_minimum_priority text;
begin
  if p_batch_size is null
     or p_batch_size < 1
     or p_batch_size > 200 then
    raise exception
      'Batch size must be between 1 and 200';
  end if;

  with expired_rows as (
    select n.id
    from public.notifications n
    where n.expires_at is not null
      and n.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
      and n.status in (
        'Scheduled',
        'Ready',
        'Delivered',
        'Read',
        'Actioned',
        'Snoozed',
        'Failed'
      )
    order by n.expires_at, n.id
    limit p_batch_size
    for update skip locked
  ),
  updated as (
    update public.notifications n
    set
      status = 'Expired'
    from expired_rows e
    where n.id = e.id
    returning n.id
  )
  select count(*)
  into v_expired
  from updated;


  with due_rows as (
    select n.id
    from public.notifications n
    where n.status in (
        'Scheduled',
        'Snoozed',
        'Failed'
      )
      and n.scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp()
      and (
        n.expires_at is null
        or n.expires_at > clock_timestamp()
      )
    order by n.scheduled_for, n.id
    limit p_batch_size
    for update skip locked
  ),
  updated as (
    update public.notifications n
    set
      status = 'Ready',
      snoozed_until = case
        when n.status = 'Snoozed' then null
        else n.snoozed_until
      end
    from due_rows d
    where n.id = d.id
    returning n.id
  )
  select count(*)
  into v_promoted
  from updated;


  for v_notification in
    select n.*
    from public.notifications n
    where n.status = 'Ready'
      and n.scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp()
      and (
        n.expires_at is null
        or n.expires_at > clock_timestamp()
      )
    order by n.scheduled_for, n.created_at, n.id
    limit p_batch_size
    for update skip locked
  loop
    v_examined := v_examined + 1;

    v_preference :=
      public.notification_effective_preference(
        v_notification.recipient_user_id,
        v_notification.category
      );

    v_notification_enabled := coalesce(
      (
        v_preference
        ->> 'notification_enabled'
      )::boolean,
      true
    );

    v_minimum_priority := coalesce(
      nullif(
        v_preference
        ->> 'minimum_priority',
        ''
      ),
      'Low'
    );

    if not v_notification_enabled
       or public.notification_priority_rank(
         v_notification.priority
       ) < public.notification_priority_rank(
         v_minimum_priority
       ) then

      update public.notifications
      set status = 'Cancelled'
      where id = v_notification.id;

      v_cancelled := v_cancelled + 1;
      continue;
    end if;

    v_in_app_enabled := coalesce(
      (
        v_preference
        ->> 'in_app_enabled'
      )::boolean,
      true
    );

    v_push_enabled := coalesce(
      (
        v_preference
        ->> 'system_push_enabled'
      )::boolean,
      true
    );


    if v_in_app_enabled then
      insert into public.notification_deliveries (
        notification_id,
        subscription_id,
        channel,
        attempt_number,
        delivery_status,
        attempted_at,
        sent_at,
        delivered_at,
        provider_status,
        response_metadata
      )
      values (
        v_notification.id,
        null,
        'InApp',
        1,
        'Delivered',
        clock_timestamp(),
        clock_timestamp(),
        clock_timestamp(),
        'InboxAvailable',
        jsonb_build_object(
          'delivery_mode', 'authoritative-inbox',
          'prepared_at', clock_timestamp()
        )
      )
      on conflict do nothing;

      get diagnostics v_insert_count = row_count;

      v_in_app_created :=
        v_in_app_created + v_insert_count;

      if v_insert_count > 0 then
        update public.notifications
        set
          status = 'Delivered',
          first_delivered_at = coalesce(
            first_delivered_at,
            clock_timestamp()
          ),
          last_delivered_at = clock_timestamp()
        where id = v_notification.id
          and status = 'Ready';
      end if;
    end if;


    if v_push_enabled then
      with active_devices as (
        select s.id
        from public.push_subscriptions s
        where s.user_id =
              v_notification.recipient_user_id
          and s.is_active = true
          and s.permission_state = 'granted'
          and s.revoked_at is null
        order by s.last_seen_at desc, s.id
      ),
      inserted as (
        insert into public.notification_deliveries (
          notification_id,
          subscription_id,
          channel,
          attempt_number,
          delivery_status,
          response_metadata
        )
        select
          v_notification.id,
          d.id,
          'WebPush',
          1,
          'Pending',
          jsonb_build_object(
            'prepared_at',
            clock_timestamp()
          )
        from active_devices d
        on conflict do nothing
        returning id
      )
      select count(*)
      into v_insert_count
      from inserted;

      v_push_deliveries_created :=
        v_push_deliveries_created
        + v_insert_count;

      if v_insert_count > 0 then
        insert into public.notification_jobs (
          notification_id,
          event_id,
          job_type,
          run_at,
          job_status,
          attempt_count,
          maximum_attempts,
          job_payload
        )
        values (
          v_notification.id,
          v_notification.event_id,
          'DeliverWebPush',
          clock_timestamp(),
          'Pending',
          0,
          5,
          jsonb_build_object(
            'notification_id',
            v_notification.id,
            'prepared_at',
            clock_timestamp()
          )
        )
        on conflict do nothing;

        get diagnostics v_insert_count = row_count;

        v_push_jobs_created :=
          v_push_jobs_created + v_insert_count;
      end if;
    end if;
  end loop;


  return jsonb_build_object(
    'expired_notifications', v_expired,
    'due_notifications_promoted', v_promoted,
    'ready_notifications_examined', v_examined,
    'notifications_cancelled_by_preference',
      v_cancelled,
    'in_app_deliveries_created',
      v_in_app_created,
    'web_push_deliveries_created',
      v_push_deliveries_created,
    'web_push_jobs_created',
      v_push_jobs_created,
    'finished_at',
      clock_timestamp()
  );
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_record_web_push_result(p_job_id bigint, p_worker_id text, p_delivery_id bigint, p_success boolean, p_provider_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_provider_message_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_error_message text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_response_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_revoke_subscription boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_job public.notification_jobs%rowtype;
  v_delivery public.notification_deliveries%rowtype;
  v_subscription public.push_subscriptions%rowtype;
  v_metadata jsonb;
begin
  if p_job_id is null then
    raise exception
      'Job ID is required';
  end if;

  if p_delivery_id is null then
    raise exception
      'Delivery ID is required';
  end if;

  if nullif(
    btrim(coalesce(p_worker_id, '')),
    ''
  ) is null then
    raise exception
      'Worker ID is required';
  end if;

  if p_success is null then
    raise exception
      'Success state is required';
  end if;

  if p_response_metadata is null
     or jsonb_typeof(
       p_response_metadata
     ) <> 'object' then
    raise exception
      'Response metadata must be a JSON object';
  end if;

  select job_row.*
  into v_job
  from public.notification_jobs job_row
  where job_row.id = p_job_id
    and job_row.job_type =
      'DeliverWebPush'
    and job_row.job_status =
      'Processing'
    and job_row.locked_by =
      btrim(p_worker_id)
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception
      'Web Push job % is not Processing or is not owned by worker %',
      p_job_id,
      btrim(p_worker_id);
  end if;

  select delivery_row.*
  into v_delivery
  from public.notification_deliveries
    delivery_row
  where delivery_row.id =
        p_delivery_id
    and delivery_row.notification_id =
        v_job.notification_id
    and delivery_row.channel =
        'WebPush'
    and delivery_row.delivery_status in (
      'Pending',
      'Failed',
      'Processing'
    )
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception
      'Web Push delivery % is unavailable for job %',
      p_delivery_id,
      p_job_id;
  end if;

  select subscription_row.*
  into v_subscription
  from public.push_subscriptions
    subscription_row
  where subscription_row.id =
        v_delivery.subscription_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception
      'Subscription for delivery % was not found',
      p_delivery_id;
  end if;

  v_metadata :=
    coalesce(
      v_delivery.response_metadata,
      '{}'::jsonb
    )
    || p_response_metadata
    || jsonb_build_object(
      'job_id',
        p_job_id,
      'worker_id',
        btrim(p_worker_id),
      'recorded_at',
        clock_timestamp()
    );

  if p_success then
    update public.notification_deliveries
    set
      delivery_status = 'Sent',
      attempt_number = greatest(
        attempt_number,
        v_job.attempt_count
      ),
      attempted_at = clock_timestamp(),
      sent_at = clock_timestamp(),
      delivered_at = null,
      failed_at = null,
      provider_status = nullif(
        btrim(
          coalesce(
            p_provider_status,
            ''
          )
        ),
        ''
      ),
      provider_message_id = nullif(
        btrim(
          coalesce(
            p_provider_message_id,
            ''
          )
        ),
        ''
      ),
      error_code = null,
      error_message = null,
      response_metadata = v_metadata
    where id = v_delivery.id
    returning *
    into v_delivery;

    update public.push_subscriptions
    set
      last_success_at =
        clock_timestamp(),
      failure_count = 0,
      last_failure_at = null
    where id = v_subscription.id
    returning *
    into v_subscription;

  else
    if nullif(
      btrim(
        coalesce(
          p_error_message,
          ''
        )
      ),
      ''
    ) is null then
      raise exception
        'Failure diagnostics are required';
    end if;

    update public.notification_deliveries
    set
      delivery_status = 'Failed',
      attempt_number = greatest(
        attempt_number,
        v_job.attempt_count
      ),
      attempted_at = clock_timestamp(),
      sent_at = null,
      delivered_at = null,
      failed_at = clock_timestamp(),
      provider_status = nullif(
        btrim(
          coalesce(
            p_provider_status,
            ''
          )
        ),
        ''
      ),
      provider_message_id = null,
      error_code = nullif(
        left(
          btrim(
            coalesce(
              p_error_code,
              ''
            )
          ),
          200
        ),
        ''
      ),
      error_message = left(
        btrim(p_error_message),
        4000
      ),
      response_metadata = v_metadata
    where id = v_delivery.id
    returning *
    into v_delivery;

    update public.push_subscriptions
    set
      failure_count =
        failure_count + 1,
      last_failure_at =
        clock_timestamp(),
      is_active = case
        when coalesce(
          p_revoke_subscription,
          false
        )
        then false
        else is_active
      end,
      permission_state = case
        when coalesce(
          p_revoke_subscription,
          false
        )
        then 'revoked'
        else permission_state
      end,
      revoked_at = case
        when coalesce(
          p_revoke_subscription,
          false
        )
        then coalesce(
          revoked_at,
          clock_timestamp()
        )
        else revoked_at
      end
    where id = v_subscription.id
    returning *
    into v_subscription;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'job_id',
      v_job.id,
    'delivery_id',
      v_delivery.id,
    'delivery_status',
      v_delivery.delivery_status,
    'subscription_id',
      v_subscription.id,
    'subscription_active',
      v_subscription.is_active,
    'permission_state',
      v_subscription.permission_state,
    'failure_count',
      v_subscription.failure_count,
    'subscription_revoked',
      v_subscription.revoked_at
        is not null
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_recover_stale_jobs(p_stale_after interval DEFAULT '00:15:00'::interval)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_recovered integer := 0;
begin
  if p_stale_after is null
     or p_stale_after < interval '1 minute'
     or p_stale_after > interval '24 hours' then
    raise exception
      'Stale-lock interval must be between 1 minute and 24 hours';
  end if;

  with stale_jobs as (
    select j.id
    from public.notification_jobs j
    where j.job_status = 'Processing'
      and j.locked_at < clock_timestamp() - p_stale_after
    order by j.locked_at, j.id
    for update skip locked
  ),
  recovered as (
    update public.notification_jobs j
    set
      job_status = case
        when j.attempt_count >= j.maximum_attempts
          then 'DeadLetter'
        else 'Failed'
      end,
      run_at = case
        when j.attempt_count >= j.maximum_attempts
          then j.run_at
        else clock_timestamp() + interval '5 minutes'
      end,
      locked_at = null,
      locked_by = null,
      failed_at = clock_timestamp(),
      last_error = 'Stale processing lock recovered automatically'
    from stale_jobs s
    where j.id = s.id
    returning j.id
  )
  select count(*)
  into v_recovered
  from recovered;

  return v_recovered;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_run_recurrence(p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_notification public.notifications%rowtype;
  v_rule public.notification_escalation_rules%rowtype;
  v_source jsonb;
  v_target uuid;

  v_examined integer := 0;
  v_resolved integer := 0;
  v_repeats_created integer := 0;
  v_escalations_created integer := 0;
  v_scope_rules_skipped integer := 0;
  v_missing_targets integer := 0;

  v_repeat_due boolean;
  v_escalation_due boolean;
  v_existing_escalation boolean;
begin
  if p_batch_size is null
     or p_batch_size < 1
     or p_batch_size > 200 then
    raise exception
      'Batch size must be between 1 and 200';
  end if;

  for v_notification in
    select n.*
    from public.notifications n
    where n.status in (
      'Scheduled',
      'Ready',
      'Delivered',
      'Read',
      'Actioned',
      'Snoozed',
      'Failed'
    )
      and n.parent_notification_id is null
    order by n.created_at, n.id
    limit p_batch_size
    for update skip locked
  loop
    v_examined := v_examined + 1;

    v_source :=
      public.notification_source_state(
        v_notification.entity_type,
        v_notification.entity_id
      );

    if coalesce(
      (v_source ->> 'supported')::boolean,
      false
    )
    and coalesce(
      (v_source ->> 'resolved')::boolean,
      false
    ) then

      update public.notifications
      set status = 'Completed'
      where id = v_notification.id
        and status in (
          'Scheduled',
          'Ready',
          'Delivered',
          'Read',
          'Actioned',
          'Snoozed',
          'Failed'
        );

      update public.notifications
      set status = 'Cancelled'
      where parent_notification_id =
            v_notification.id
        and status in (
          'Scheduled',
          'Ready',
          'Delivered',
          'Read',
          'Actioned',
          'Snoozed',
          'Failed'
        );

      update public.notification_jobs
      set
        job_status = 'Cancelled',
        locked_at = null,
        locked_by = null
      where notification_id in (
        select n.id
        from public.notifications n
        where n.id = v_notification.id
           or n.parent_notification_id =
              v_notification.id
      )
        and job_status in (
          'Pending',
          'Processing',
          'Failed'
        );

      v_resolved := v_resolved + 1;
      continue;
    end if;


    for v_rule in
      select r.*
      from public.notification_escalation_rules r
      where r.is_enabled = true
        and r.category =
            v_notification.category
        and (
          r.event_type is null
          or exists (
            select 1
            from public.notification_events e
            where e.id =
                  v_notification.event_id
              and e.event_type =
                  r.event_type
          )
        )
        and public.notification_priority_rank(
          v_notification.priority
        ) >= public.notification_priority_rank(
          r.source_priority
        )
      order by r.id
    loop
      v_repeat_due :=
        v_rule.repeat_every_minutes is not null
        and coalesce(
          v_notification.repeat_count,
          0
        ) < coalesce(
          v_rule.maximum_repeat_count,
          0
        )
        and clock_timestamp() >=
          v_notification.created_at
          + make_interval(
              mins =>
                coalesce(
                  v_rule.first_repeat_after_minutes,
                  v_rule.repeat_every_minutes
                )
                +
                (
                  coalesce(
                    v_notification.repeat_count,
                    0
                  )
                  *
                  v_rule.repeat_every_minutes
                )
            );

      if v_repeat_due then
        insert into public.notifications (
          event_id,
          recipient_user_id,
          category,
          severity,
          priority,
          title,
          message,
          entity_type,
          entity_id,
          employee_sys_id,
          project_id,
          action_label,
          action_route,
          action_params,
          status,
          scheduled_for,
          expires_at,
          dedupe_key,
          repeat_count,
          escalation_level,
          parent_notification_id,
          escalation_rule_id
        )
        values (
          v_notification.event_id,
          v_notification.recipient_user_id,
          v_notification.category,
          v_notification.severity,
          v_notification.priority,
          v_notification.title,
          v_notification.message,
          v_notification.entity_type,
          v_notification.entity_id,
          v_notification.employee_sys_id,
          v_notification.project_id,
          v_notification.action_label,
          v_notification.action_route,
          v_notification.action_params,
          'Ready',
          clock_timestamp(),
          v_notification.expires_at,
          v_notification.dedupe_key ||
            ':repeat:' ||
            (
              v_notification.repeat_count + 1
            )::text,
          v_notification.repeat_count + 1,
          v_notification.escalation_level,
          v_notification.id,
          v_rule.id
        )
        on conflict do nothing;

        if found then
          update public.notifications
          set repeat_count =
                repeat_count + 1
          where id = v_notification.id;

          v_notification.repeat_count :=
            v_notification.repeat_count + 1;

          v_repeats_created :=
            v_repeats_created + 1;
        end if;
      end if;


      v_escalation_due :=
        clock_timestamp() >=
          v_notification.created_at
          + make_interval(
              mins =>
                v_rule.escalation_after_minutes
            );

      if not v_escalation_due then
        continue;
      end if;

      select exists (
        select 1
        from public.notifications child
        where child.parent_notification_id =
              v_notification.id
          and child.escalation_rule_id =
              v_rule.id
          and child.escalation_level > 0
      )
      into v_existing_escalation;

      if v_existing_escalation then
        continue;
      end if;

      if v_rule.project_scope_required then
        v_scope_rules_skipped :=
          v_scope_rules_skipped + 1;
        continue;
      end if;


      if v_rule.escalation_target_user_id
         is not null then

        if exists (
          select 1
          from public.profiles p
          where p.id =
                v_rule.escalation_target_user_id
            and p.is_active = true
        ) then
          v_target :=
            v_rule.escalation_target_user_id;
        else
          v_target := null;
          v_missing_targets :=
            v_missing_targets + 1;
        end if;

        if v_target is not null then
          insert into public.notifications (
            event_id,
            recipient_user_id,
            category,
            severity,
            priority,
            title,
            message,
            entity_type,
            entity_id,
            employee_sys_id,
            project_id,
            action_label,
            action_route,
            action_params,
            status,
            scheduled_for,
            expires_at,
            dedupe_key,
            repeat_count,
            escalation_level,
            parent_notification_id,
            escalation_rule_id
          )
          values (
            v_notification.event_id,
            v_target,
            v_notification.category,
            v_notification.severity,
            v_notification.priority,
            v_notification.title,
            v_notification.message,
            v_notification.entity_type,
            v_notification.entity_id,
            v_notification.employee_sys_id,
            v_notification.project_id,
            v_notification.action_label,
            v_notification.action_route,
            v_notification.action_params,
            'Ready',
            clock_timestamp(),
            v_notification.expires_at,
            v_notification.dedupe_key ||
              ':escalation:' ||
              v_rule.id::text ||
              ':' ||
              v_target::text,
            0,
            v_notification.escalation_level + 1,
            v_notification.id,
            v_rule.id
          )
          on conflict do nothing;

          if found then
            v_escalations_created :=
              v_escalations_created + 1;
          end if;
        end if;


      elsif v_rule.escalation_target_role
            is not null then

        for v_target in
          select p.id
          from public.profiles p
          where p.is_active = true
            and p.role =
                v_rule.escalation_target_role
          order by p.id
        loop
          insert into public.notifications (
            event_id,
            recipient_user_id,
            category,
            severity,
            priority,
            title,
            message,
            entity_type,
            entity_id,
            employee_sys_id,
            project_id,
            action_label,
            action_route,
            action_params,
            status,
            scheduled_for,
            expires_at,
            dedupe_key,
            repeat_count,
            escalation_level,
            parent_notification_id,
            escalation_rule_id
          )
          values (
            v_notification.event_id,
            v_target,
            v_notification.category,
            v_notification.severity,
            v_notification.priority,
            v_notification.title,
            v_notification.message,
            v_notification.entity_type,
            v_notification.entity_id,
            v_notification.employee_sys_id,
            v_notification.project_id,
            v_notification.action_label,
            v_notification.action_route,
            v_notification.action_params,
            'Ready',
            clock_timestamp(),
            v_notification.expires_at,
            v_notification.dedupe_key ||
              ':escalation:' ||
              v_rule.id::text ||
              ':' ||
              v_target::text,
            0,
            v_notification.escalation_level + 1,
            v_notification.id,
            v_rule.id
          )
          on conflict do nothing;

          if found then
            v_escalations_created :=
              v_escalations_created + 1;
          end if;
        end loop;

        if not found then
          v_missing_targets :=
            v_missing_targets + 1;
        end if;
      end if;
    end loop;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'notifications_examined',
      v_examined,
    'resolved_notifications_completed',
      v_resolved,
    'repeat_notifications_created',
      v_repeats_created,
    'escalation_notifications_created',
      v_escalations_created,
    'project_scope_rules_skipped',
      v_scope_rules_skipped,
    'missing_or_inactive_targets',
      v_missing_targets,
    'finished_at',
      clock_timestamp()
  );
end
$function$

declare
  v_user_id uuid;
begin
  v_user_id := auth.uid();

  if v_user_id is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Authenticated session required';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles profile_row
    where profile_row.id = v_user_id
      and profile_row.is_active = true
  ) then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Active profile required';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    subscription_row.id,
    subscription_row.device_label,
    subscription_row.browser_name,
    subscription_row.platform_name,
    subscription_row.permission_state,
    subscription_row.is_active,
    subscription_row.last_seen_at,
    subscription_row.last_success_at,
    subscription_row.last_failure_at,
    subscription_row.failure_count,
    subscription_row.revoked_at,
    subscription_row.created_at,
    subscription_row.updated_at
  from public.push_subscriptions subscription_row
  where subscription_row.user_id = v_user_id
  order by
    subscription_row.is_active desc,
    subscription_row.last_seen_at desc,
    subscription_row.id desc;

 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid;
  v_endpoint text;
  v_endpoint_hash text;
  v_existing public.push_subscriptions%rowtype;
  v_subscription public.push_subscriptions%rowtype;
begin
  v_user_id := auth.uid();

  if v_user_id is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Authentication is required';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = v_user_id
      and p.is_active = true
  ) then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'Active user profile is required';
  end if;

  v_endpoint := btrim(coalesce(p_endpoint, ''));

  if v_endpoint = '' then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'Push endpoint is required';
  end if;

  if btrim(coalesce(p_p256dh_key, '')) = '' then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'Push p256dh key is required';
  end if;

  if btrim(coalesce(p_auth_key, '')) = '' then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'Push auth key is required';
  end if;

  if v_endpoint !~ '^https://' then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '23514',
      message = 'Push endpoint must use HTTPS';
  end if;

  v_endpoint_hash := md5(v_endpoint);

  select s.*
  into v_existing
  from public.push_subscriptions s
  where s.endpoint_hash = v_endpoint_hash
  for update;

  if found and v_existing.user_id <> v_user_id then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '23505',
      message = 'This push subscription belongs to another user';
  end if;

  if found then
    update public.push_subscriptions s
    set
      endpoint = v_endpoint,
      p256dh_key = btrim(p_p256dh_key),
      auth_key = btrim(p_auth_key),
      device_label = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_device_label, '')), ''),
      browser_name = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_browser_name, '')), ''),
      platform_name = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_platform_name, '')), ''),
      user_agent = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_user_agent, '')), ''),
      permission_state = 'granted',
      is_active = true,
      revoked_at = null,
      last_seen_at = now()
    where s.id = v_existing.id
      and s.user_id = v_user_id
    returning s.*
    into v_subscription;

  else
    insert into public.push_subscriptions (
      user_id,
      endpoint,
      endpoint_hash,
      p256dh_key,
      auth_key,
      device_label,
      browser_name,
      platform_name,
      user_agent,
      permission_state,
      is_active,
      last_seen_at
    )
    values (
      v_user_id,
      v_endpoint,
      v_endpoint_hash,
      btrim(p_p256dh_key),
      btrim(p_auth_key),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_device_label, '')), ''),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_browser_name, '')), ''),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_platform_name, '')), ''),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_user_agent, '')), ''),
      'granted',
      true,
      now()
    )
    returning *
    into v_subscription;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'subscription_id', v_subscription.id,
    'device_label', v_subscription.device_label,
    'browser_name', v_subscription.browser_name,
    'platform_name', v_subscription.platform_name,
    'is_active', v_subscription.is_active,
    'permission_state', v_subscription.permission_state,
    'last_seen_at', v_subscription.last_seen_at
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.uniform_order_accounting(p_order_id bigint)

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    coalesce(o.approved_sets, 0)::integer,
    coalesce((
      select sum(e.set_quantity)
      from public.uniform_order_employees e
      where e.order_id = o.id and e.is_active = true
    ), 0)::bigint,
    coalesce((
      select sum(p.set_quantity)
      from public.uniform_order_postponements p
      where p.order_id = o.id and p.status in ('Open','Partially Activated')
    ), 0)::bigint,
    (
      coalesce(o.approved_sets, 0)
      - coalesce((
          select sum(e.set_quantity)
          from public.uniform_order_employees e
          where e.order_id = o.id and e.is_active = true

      - coalesce((
          select sum(p.set_quantity)
          from public.uniform_order_postponements p
          where p.order_id = o.id and p.status in ('Open','Partially Activated')
        ), 0)
    )::bigint
  from public.uniform_supply_orders o
  where o.id = p_order_id;
$function$
